subtitles.en: They'd like to pick up a loyal customer. That's not typically what you get out of these low-cost carriers like Frontier and Spirit, right? This is not those well-heeled folks that are filling the loyalty program at Delta.

subtitles.en: It's a very challenging market right now, right? Ferris have moved, sorry, fuel has moved, toy, it's doubled. And the airlines have to recoup that in order to stay profitable. None of them will be as profitable in two queue, if you believe they're guidance, as they were in the last two queue.

title_lines: 低成本航司还能撑多久？
title_highlights: 低成本航司还能撑多久？

subtitles.en: Yes, spirits a unique case. It was dealing with issues for a much longer time as we've been discussing here, George.
subtitles.zh: 精神航空是特例，它的问题由来已久。

subtitles.en: But some of the pressures that were brought to bear on spirit are shared by a lot of these other carriers. Yeah, it's a very challenged business in the US and so first ultra-low-cost is sort of equated to like a Ryanair-type airline in Europe.
subtitles.zh: 但精神航空面临的压力，其他航司也有。美国超低成本模式类似欧洲瑞安航空，但挑战更大。

subtitles.en: It doesn't seem to have taken off as well in the US and lately the dynamic in the market is very challenging, right?
subtitles.zh: 这种模式在美国似乎不太成功，近期市场动态充满挑战。

subtitles.en: Because if you look at the big full-service carriers, you look at United and Delta, especially, the way they're running their business right now is they, one, they have these big premium programs where they give their loyal customers, you know, they have a credit card, they buy their dinners and they buy their groceries on that card and the airline sells miles to the credit card company and generates a bunch of revenue on that.
subtitles.zh: 大型全服务航司如美联航和达美，通过高端会员计划和信用卡合作创造大量收入。

subtitles.en: And Delta makes some $4 billion or so a year on that. Then they use premium front cabin, extra leg room, all kinds of crazy things to boost revenue.
subtitles.zh: 达美每年因此赚约40亿美元，还通过高级舱位、腿部空间等提升收入。

subtitles.en: And remember in the back of all their airplanes, they tell people is a little spirit airlines or a little frontier. They sell those fares, they can tighten those down a bit to be very competitive against spirit and frontier, cover the marginal cost of flying that airplane plus a little bit.
subtitles.zh: 他们飞机后舱类似迷你精神航空，可压低票价与低成本航司竞争，覆盖边际成本。

subtitles.en: If they fill the airplane 90, 100%, they get great efficiencies, they've subsidized a bit of the back of the airplane and they're taking spirit and frontier sort of, you know, they're hurting them in the marketplace.
subtitles.zh: 若客座率90-100%，效率极高，后舱补贴，从而挤压精神航空和边疆航空的市场空间。

subtitles.en: So in the US, because we don't see this dynamic in Europe and other parts of the world, they don't have the credit card fees that they can count on in other parts of the world in the US, I think this model is getting very challenging.
subtitles.zh: 美国缺乏欧洲那样的信用卡收入支撑，这种模式在美国愈发艰难。

subtitles.en: And so I think that we're going to have to see a slim down in those low cost carriers in the US, I think in order to keep them viable.
subtitles.zh: 因此，美国低成本航司可能需要瘦身才能维持生存。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
